title: FPL Squad Planner
tagline: Build a 15-man Fantasy Premier League squad against live prices, budget, and quota rules — no spreadsheet
highlights: A GitHub Action fetches live FPL data twice daily and commits it into the repo, so the site reads a same-origin file with no live API call and no CORS workaround needed
Enforces real squad-building rules client-side: £100m budget, 2/5/5/3 position quota, 3-per-club cap
Every scheduled data refresh auto-redeploys on Vercel — the site is always at most a few hours stale, with zero manual updates
